abilitygroupinfo.slug: Wars may be fought with weapons, but they are won by men.

action.name: Experience Sets In
action.precondition: Lucky or Righteous physical attack on a creature of the given specialization.
action.critsuccess: As for success but +3 to hit damage.
action.righteoussuccess: As for success but +2 to hit damage.
action.success: +1 to all further physical attacks to hit damage by this character against creatures of this type during this combat.
action.any-fail: No effect, though the character may make an attempt the next time the preconditions are met during this combat.

abilitydescription.p: The character bears an animosity towards, and/or has been trained to fight opponents of a given monster-class.

This ability is triggered after a character with this ability makes their first successful blessed melee attack against a creature having a monster-class that this character is adversarial to. Once triggered the characters training/experience kicks in and the ability remains active for the rest of the combat.
While triggered the character gains a bonus equal to their adversary rank for combat checks against monsters of the given monster-class (the bonus is to the check only and not to damage).
The character takes the brunt of the attack on their armour, hoping that it will protect them. A character may be harder to hit because they are wearing heavier armour or carrying a shield.

The bonus for this check is determined by the rank of this ability plus a modifier for the armour the character is wearing. The armour modifier is +2 for very heavy armour, +1 for heavy armour, +0 for medium armour, -1 for light armour and -3 for None, with an additional +1 if using a shield.

playexample.p: Dourli has Armour 2 and is wearing banded mail, which is heavy armour, he gets attacked by two goblins. He blocks the first attack with his shield, using his OOTA for the turn. He has to use an Armour Save for the second attack since he has no OOTAs remaining. He rolls dice and adds +4 to the skill result to defend; +1 for the heavy armour, +1 for the shield, and +2 for his ranks in armour.

abilitydescription.p: ability:armour Armour Save Instead of making an armour check the character may choose to dodge, shield block, parry or use some other attack-reaction ability. However, because Armour Saves are free they tend to be used as the defence of last resort for all but the most heavily armoured.
Some attacks cannot be defended with armour, a dragons breath weapon. If no other defence ability can be used the attack automatically does normal damage.

action.name: Trigger Frenzy
action.precondition: A successful melee hit in combat.
action.any-success: Character may decide to enter or leave the Blood Frenzy state.

abilitydescription.p: After your character makes a successful melee attack you can make a save to see if you enter a Blood Frenzy.

Blood Frenzy Condition
Condition Blood Frenzy
While a character has the Blood Frenzy Condition they get advantage on standard basic melee attacks. During this time the character must perform a basic melee attack every turn, moving to attack if necessary. The character must pay the pool cost at the start of each round to maintain this ability. The frenzy ends when the character runs out of Mettle, when they perform a turn without attacking anything, or when they make a second successful Trigger Frenzy check to lose this condition. While in a frenzy if the character cannot reach an enemy then they must attack an ally if they can.

action.name: Grapple
action.precondition: Opponent must not be much larger than the character.
action.dmg: Depends on the type of Brawl action chosen.

action.name: Guard
action.effect: Shift the result down against lethal attacks. Make the save at advantage against grappled opponents.

action.name: Punch
action.dmg: 1d2+Str damage, +2 if the attacker is wearing gauntlets.

action.name: Headbutt
action.precondition: Opponent must not be much larger than the character.
action.dmg: Depends on the type of Brawl action chosen.

abilitydescription.p: Brawling is the art of unarmed combat. It involves grappling, head butting, or punching opponents. Brawl damage is non-lethal. The check is shifted down twice if the opponent is larger than the brawler.

Grappling See Brawl/Grappling
Grappling involves grabbing, tackling or wrestling an opponent and holding them without harming them too much. Other attacks against a grappled opponent are hindered by the grappler being close to the opponent and the opponents struggling. Every round that an opponent is grappled they may make an opposed Brawl|Str save against their grappler to escape. Once grappled it takes a round for a second character to tie-up, or otherwise constrain, the opponent.

Head Butt See Brawl/Head Butt
A Head Butt involves the attacker driving their head into the bridge of the defenders nose. Head butting is mainly used as an attack of last resort or as a surprise attack. An attacker may only head butt someone immediately in front or behind them. An character may head butt when grappled or otherwise constrained. Head butts do 1d2+Str damage, +1 damage if the attacker is wearing a helmet and -1 damage if the defender is wearing a helmet.

Punch See Brawl/Punch
Kick See Brawl/Kick
When a character makes a Punch or Kick attack the attacker attempts to hit their opponent using their fists. The attack is a Brawl vs Targets Defence. It does 1d2+Str damage, +2 damage if the attacker is wearing gauntlets.

action.name: Talent
action.precondition: Lucky success in a melee attack against an opponent of Appropriate Size
action.effect: Make a Brawl attack with a Dirty Fighter Rank bonus.

abilitydescription.p: When the character makes a lucky successful melee attack, they may immediately make a free brawl attack as a minor action adding their Dirty-Fighter Rank to any damage that the Brawl attack does.

The character may attempt to dodge, to leap out of the way of the attack, instead of making an armour roll. Doing so uses the characters reaction for the round. If successful the attack is dodged and the character takes no damage.

Some types of attack cannot be dodged, e.g. surprise attacks or poisonous gas attacks. Other types of attack the acid or fire attacks of dragons may be dodgeable depending on the context and deal half or no damage (at the GM's discretion).

Once per movement action the attacker may use his mass and strength to brush aside those who stand in his way. Such is the force of his unstoppable charge that at most one opportunity attack can be made against him. The pushed opponent cannot make an opportunity attack against the Juggernaut.
Note that the Juggernaut ability may only be used against opponents of similar or smaller size and strength.
This ability is used to throw objects.

ability:parry When a character is attacked they may attempt to parry the blow when using a mace or sword instead of making an armour roll. If the parry result fails and a boon is rolled the attack deals half damage. If the parry result fails and a bane is rolled the attack deals double damage. It may not be possible to parry certain types of attack, for example breath weapons cannot be parried.
When the characters health drops to 0 they can instantly make a Retribution check and if successful the character may immediately perform a free charge or melee attack.
